title: A one-time default is the odd choice out among benchmark charities
statement: The subject defaults its donation form to one-time while both benchmark charities default to monthly, making it the only one of the three that does not lead with recurring giving.
implication: A donor comparing causes sees recurring framed as the norm everywhere except here.
audience_relevance: Prospective monthly donors researching before a first gift are the ones the default reaches first.

title: The ask precedes any proof of impact
statement: A prospective donor is asked to give before seeing any statement of what the gift funds.
implication: A donor deciding whether to trust the cause has nothing to weigh before being asked.
audience_relevance: A donor converting from one-time to recurring is weighing continued trust, not first impressions.
